title: Smt. Indira Nehru Gandhi v. Shri Raj Narain

content.caseIdentity: Smt. Indira Nehru Gandhi v. Shri Raj Narain, 1975 Supp SCC 1
content.facts: Constitutional changes affecting election adjudication were challenged.
questionsBeforeCourt: Whether essential constitutional principles may be displaced by amendment.
Whether constitutional arrangements can remove essential judicial and democratic controls.
content.ratioDecidendi: Rule of law, democracy and judicial review are integral to the constitutional structure.
content.holding: The impugned provisions were invalid to the extent they damaged basic constitutional principles.
content.relevance: Use for rule of law and constitutional limitations.
